chunks: And indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) passed away, and his head was on my chest.
And indeed, his soul flowed into my palm, so I passed it over my face.

And indeed, I was appointed to perform his funeral bath (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family), and the angels were my helpers, so the house and the courtyard were filled with them, some descending and some ascending,
and a humming sound from them did not leave my ears, as they invoked blessings upon him, until we buried him in his grave.
ai.seo_question: What happened during the Prophet's death and funeral according to this narration?
ai.summary: This narration, traditionally attributed to Ali ibn Abi Talib, vividly depicts the Prophet's passing with Ali holding his head and catching his breath, emphasizing his unique intimacy and authority. The account highlights the celestial assistance during the ritual bath (Ghusl), where angels served as helpers, filling the house with their presence until the burial, underscoring the divine nature of the Prophet's transition.
